topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: US-0092 shipped browser_smoke and manual_operator probes but browser_smoke returns UAT_PROBE_UNRESOLVED and manual UI steps are not auto-run; operator wants its-magic to self-test apps using Cursor built-in browser (navigate, click, type, console/network evidence) for maximum automation.

Cursor IDE agent sessions running its-magic /qa and /verify-work in kit and downstream repos; merged scratchpad; optional local dev servers; composes on scripts/uat_probe_lib.py and US-0065 webapp runtime verification.

Python stdlib uat_probe_lib extensions plus agent-command contracts in .cursor/commands (verify-work, qa, execute); optional Playwright or HTTP curl fallback subprocess when Cursor browser MCP is unavailable; contract tests in tests/.

Extend DEC-0078 probe catalog without weakening fail-closed semantics: agent-executed Cursor browser path as primary for web stacks; stdlib probe lib records evidence refs and orchestrates fallbacks; spawn-only subagents unchanged.

Default-on browser self-test when web stack detected and health URL or dev-server port resolves; operator-visible evidence artifacts (screenshot paths, console error counts) in uat.json; PERMISSION_MODE and browser approval settings respected per Cursor security model.

Browser probes must not auto-read .env or submit secrets; respect Cursor browser approval modes; fail closed UAT_PROBE_FORBIDDEN on secret paths; no silent PASS when browser tools unavailable unless explicit fallback probe succeeds.

Reliability via contract tests and uat_probe_lib --self-test; bounded probe timeouts; deterministic reason codes; template parity US-0017; compose US-0092 full_autonomy self-verify without false PASS on browser steps.

Single story US-0093 closes the browser/manual UAT gap from prior /ask thread; deliver browser_smoke execution, automatable manual_operator UI routing, process_health and cli_smoke stub completion, docs and tests in one vertical upgrade.
